68:     script_start: TextRange,
69:     comments: &mut std::iter::Peekable<I>,
70:     locator: &Locator,
71: ) -> bool
72: where
73:     I: Iterator<Item = TextRange>,

76:     let rest = locator.after(line_end);

81:         let Some(content) = script_line_content(&line) else {

83:         };

85:         if content == "///" {
86:             // > Precedence for an ending line # /// is given when the next line is not a valid

88:             // > For example, the following is a single fully valid block:
89:             // > ```python
90:             // > # /// some-toml
91:             // > # embedded-csharp = """
92:             // > # /// <summary>
93:             // > # /// text

97:             // > # """
